Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
7:35 AM

Here is a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with mornings for sightseeing and a rest in the afternoon.

Day 1, Old city: City Palace, Jantar Mantar and a drive past Hawa Mahal for photos. Have lunch at a nearby restaurant, rest, then visit Johari Bazaar in the evening for shopping and sweets.
Day 2, Amber Fort: Go early, before the crowds and the heat. Jeeps or cars can take them up the hill, so there is no long climb. Stop at Jal Mahal on the way back, then see Nahargarh Fort at sunset.
Day 3, Easy day: Albert Hall Museum, then Birla Mandir and a slow lunch. Spend the evening at Chokhi Dhani for Rajasthani food and folk music before they head home.

Stay near the old city or MI Road so everything is a short ride away. Booking one car with a driver for all three days is the simplest way to travel.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:39 AM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue-Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card. The site also lists the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries as closed for renovation (notice dated 29 May 2023), so check before you go.
